text: A. Brennan lets fly from 11 metres... so close for Redmoor FC!
GOAL! D. Moreau buries it! Redmoor FC make it 1-0.
Redmoor FC have camped in Halvard Athletic's half. Halvard Athletic simply can't get a touch.
Now hold on. What if H. Sørensen had stepped up?
Same moment, one change, and no goal! It's 0-0, not 1-0.
And there it is again! D. Moreau with another! 2-0 to Redmoor FC now.
It's all Redmoor FC now. Halvard Athletic are chasing shadows.
A. Brennan has a go from 14 metres! Inches away. Redmoor FC will be kicking themselves.
Another sight of goal for F. Delacroix, 12 metres out... not this time! Halvard Athletic keep searching.
A. Brennan lets fly from 12 metres... so close for Redmoor FC!
